description: Use one payment header and keep Authorization for the Panes key. Missing payment returns 402 with WWW-Authenticate (MPP) or PAYMENT-REQUIRED (x402) and payment in the JSON body. Stripe SPT payload is {spt,externalId}; x402 v2 payload includes resource, accepted requirements, signature and EIP-3009 authorization. The exact issued quote must match. A pending or uncertain payment must be polled, never repaid. Checkout returns a browser URL.
name: topup_pay
